newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Pacific Breweries sees lower profit.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pacific Breweries sees lower profit.

text.p: Asia Pacific Breweries Ltd said on Friday it expects a reduction in its profits in the year ahead due to start up costs at its new breweries in Cambodia and Hainan, China.
It said it had recently commissioned a new brewery in Cambodia and would shortly commission another in Hainan as part of its regional expansion policy.

"While confident that such developments will strengthen the group's long-term position, the directors expect that start-up costs will result in a reduction in profits in the year ahead," the company said in a statement accompanying its results.
It said production capacity at its Ho Chi Minh City brewery had just been expanded, which should allow the group to continue tapping the growing demand for its brands in Vietnam.
